name: Pithouse · Elder Introduction
notes: Pithouse placement calibrated from original SuperSplat settings: SOG rotates +180° on Z, while camera, NPC and annotation positions remain in original viewer world coordinates. Historical dialogue is illustrative pending cultural review.

spawn.note: Player eye at approximately 1.65 m, positioned 1.95 m toward the hearth from original wall-edge annotation camera; runtime raycasts against voxels to find the floor.

colliders.note: Static Elder interaction capsule approximation. Blocks player movement while allowing dialogue proximity.

characters.name: Elder
characters.placementNote: Starter approximation: near original hearth annotation and beside the base of the center pole. Adjust with Blender NPC_Elder placement once mesh is overlaid.
characters.notes: Blender 5.x combined skinned GLB: one mesh, one 33-joint armature, three embedded NLA clips. 1.7x scale compensates for roughly 1-metre GLB mesh height; verify against SOG.

collectibles.name: Study Stone
collectibles.note: A demonstration study stone. Examine it before deciding whether to collect it. You can ask the Elder about what you've found.

welcome.speaker: Elder
welcome.text: Welcome inside the Pithouse. What would you like to learn about?

choices.text: I just want to look around.

building.speaker: Elder
building.text: Look toward the center pole. We can examine the structure together and consider how this space was built.

choices.text: What is the center pole for?

pole.speaker: Elder
pole.text: The center pole is a good place to start examining the construction. Select its marker to inspect the original annotation.

warmth.speaker: Elder
warmth.text: There is an important distinction between a fire and a place where warm embers and stones are collected. Let's look at the annotated area.

warmthDetail.speaker: Elder
warmthDetail.text: This marked area was used for collecting warm stones and embers. When you are ready, we can return to your other questions.

stoneDiscussion.speaker: Elder
stoneDiscussion.text: You have found the study stone. We can look at how people made use of materials and objects in their daily lives. This is example text pending historical review.

topics.speaker: Elder
topics.text: What would you like to explore next?

choices.text: Tell me about the center pole.
I want to explore on my own.

startup.hint: Walk to the Elder and press E, or use gamepad A to interact.

elder.note: Conversation close-up from in front of the Elder looking toward their upper torso.

hearth.note: Elevated view toward original annotated warm-ember collection location.

centerPole.note: Uses actual center-pole marker from original SuperSplat settings.json; shot authored to look upward along pole.
